title: gui: Graph v2 — real-name labels, clustering, layouts, filters
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W3]
Seats: GRAPH-05, GRAPH-06, GRAPH-07
Upgrade crates/gui/src/graph/*: always-readable REAL symbol names (zoom-aware LOD: full name -> short -> hidden, never id-only), clustering by module/crate/dir (group hull or collapsed super-nodes), layout modes (force existing, hierarchical by module depth, radial around selection), filters (edge kind, confidence, module, language, entrypoints-only), focus+context dimming (existing), call-site edge labels on hover, search-to-focus. Keep honest dashed `?` unresolved edges. Owner: crates/gui/src/graph/*. Verify: cargo build/clippy/test -p repowalk-gui; on repowalk every visible node label is a real name (spot-check in report).

EVIDENCE (seats GRAPH-06/07, lead TL-GRAPH; batch B3):
Files (ownership crates/gui/src/graph/** only): render.rs (rewritten: NodeInfo/EdgeInfo/NodeInfo label+short+is_cluster+cluster_size+god, LOD shapes, legend+filter strip), filter.rs (new: pure filter/cluster predicates + GraphUiState/BuildSig), interaction.rs (neighbourhood keep-set, search dimming, cluster-aware tooltip), mod.rs (declare filter module). No file outside graph/** touched; app.rs untouched (its `(edges,symbols,calls,imports)` GraphState signature preserved).
Real-name labels + LOD: NodeInfo.label is always a real name (symbol name / file path / module), label_of logic moved into raw_info; `short` is the leaf segment (name after last `::`/`.`, truncated 16). Custom shape draws full name on hover/selection or zoom>=1.15, short name for zoom in [0.55,1.15), nothing below 0.55; clusters keep a `module (n)` caption down to 0.45. Ids appear ONLY in the hover tooltip/inspector (muted monospace next to signature:file:line).
Clustering by module: collapsed module members reroute to `cluster:<module>` super-nodes via filter::cluster_key (uses App::module_of, the file path); drawn as a rounded box with module_color border, caption `module (size)`; size = distinct members (symbols+files). Cluster assignment and node/edge order are deterministic (BTreeMap/BTreeSet by id; cap ties broken by id). Create clusters from the legend `cluster ▾` menu (checkbox per module); expand by clicking the on-canvas cluster (GraphChange::NodeClicked) or the `expand N clusters` button.
Filters: edge kind via existing calls/imports toggles; confidence selector `exact only` (ConfidenceFilter::All keeps non-Exact dashed, ExactOnly hides them); module ComboBox (App::module_of); search-to-highlight text box (case-insensitive over label/short/id/module) that dims non-matches without rebuilding. Filter/cluster state lives in egui temp memory (GraphUiState) so App is not widened.
Selection sync: unchanged click path selects the symbol (app.select(Selection::Symbol(id))) / file; selected node's neighbourhood (focus + direct callers/callees) stays lit and everything else dims; search and selection keep-sets union. Trace path focus still highlights only the resolved path.
Confidence (R-20 honesty): EdgeKind/Confidence carried on EdgeInfo; `dashed = filter::is_dashed(confidence)` = anything not Exact; non-Exact edges draw dashed with a `?` badge; Unresolved edges are dropped (no trustworthy endpoint) and the legend states `dashed ? = low confidence`.
Honest states: no index -> "No index yet — open a repository to build the call graph."; empty result -> "No nodes match the current filters." (or the no-resolved-edges variant when no filter is active) instead of a blank canvas; cap for legibility = filter::NODE_CAP = 400 nodes, kept by top fan-in; when capped a WARNING banner says `showing X of Y nodes — capped at 400 for legibility (top fan-in kept)`. Legend shows live `N nodes · M edges`. God-files (metrics::god_files via app.analysis) get a WARNING shoulder dot; legend hint `▢ cluster · ◆ god file`.
Perf: graph rebuilt only when the BuildSig changes (repo+indexed_at+edge/symbol counts+toggles+confidence+module+collapsed); search never rebuilds; per frame is only Arc<Index> clone + shape updates (no graph/analysis clone).
Tests (>=2 added; 11 new): filter.rs 5 (only_non_exact_is_dashed, confidence_filter_exact_only_hides_dashed, kind_toggle_matrix, cluster_key_only_for_listed_modules, empty_search_matches_and_is_case_insensitive); render.rs 6 (labels_are_real_names_and_non_exact_edges_are_dashed, clustering_is_deterministic_and_collapses_only_listed_modules, empty_and_filtered_states_do_not_panic_and_report_zero, cap_truncates_deterministically_and_is_reported, short_label_is_the_leaf_segment, learned_index_labels_are_real_names — runs core learn on a temp crate and asserts no visible label is a path:line id); interaction.rs neighbourhood test updated.
Real-index spot-check: learned_index_labels_are_real_names asserts main→helper resolves and every node label is a real name (no ':'), on a learned index. GATES (real): cargo fmt -p repowalk-gui -- --check -> exit 0; cargo clippy -p repowalk-gui --all-targets -- -D warnings -> Finished (0 warnings); cargo test -p repowalk-gui -> 77 passed / 0 failed (14 graph:: tests). CAP introduced: 400 nodes (reported, never silent). No new dependencies. Not committed/pushed. Note: transient clippy failure seen in crates/core/src/pipeline.rs (core team, in flight) resolved before the final green run.
